landing_point.why: The advisory names the Gearman worker; runJob unserializes $job->workload() here.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: exportCallback unserializes $task->data() from Gearman task results; a variant without allowed_classes is plausible.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The client-side unserialize of the worker's reply in send()/sendBackground() (line 77); a planted copy without the option is plausible.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It sits in a lower-level client wrapper in another package, and a maintainer may treat replies as trusted.

O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: DB-stored state crosses a save/reload boundary and looks unrelated to Gearman.
